sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 21:55)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radio, 2 x Bodycam, 1 x Swipe Key. All photos and videos to be attached to the end-of-shift report.
Guard arrived at the office; short debrief before commencing patrols on Queen Street to Aotea Square.
Debrief completed; commencing patrols up Queen Street to Aotea Square.
Welfare check; standing by at Queen Street McDonald's:
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street; commencing welfare checks down Queen Street.
Welfare checks from Mecca and Farmers down to Hallensteins and OPSM, all clear, no issues. Standing by in the middle of Queen Street.
Full sweep of Wyndham Street with welfare checks at Qftav and Chemist Warehouse; continuing patrols down Queen Street.
Commencing welfare checks through Vulcan Lane.
Response call from Cotton On regarding a female individual smoking outside the premises; en route to the location.
Arrived at the response location; kindly approached the female vagrant and asked her to leave, all clear. Standing by until the vagrant leaves the site.
The vagrant and her belongings have been moved along; patrolling to Q Theatre.
Welfare check at Aotea Square; patrolling up to Q Theatre for a welfare check.
Welfare check at Q Theatre; had a chat with the owner of the premises regarding the specific location of the area they want covered by a trespass. Heading back to HQ to charge the Ops Phone.
Arrived at Headquarters; charging the Ops Phone due to low percentage.
Floor checks completed; gearing up and commencing patrols.
Full sweep of Darby Street with welfare checks at Darby station and its guards, Celines and Mali Thai, all clear. Patrolling Elliott Street.
Full sweep of Elliott Street with welfare checks at Wilson Carpark, the Atrium Food Court and Elliott Stables.
Full sweep of Te Waihorotiu train station, all clear; taking the lift and patrolling up Victoria Street West.
Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store, all clear, no issues. Patrolling Federal Street.
Full sweep of Federal Street; patrolling Federal Square and commencing a sweep.
Full sweep of Federal Square with welfare checks at the Cathedral and Liston House; patrolling to Albert Street.
Welfare check at Ace Karaoke and Albert Shopping Mart; patrolling Albert Street.
Full sweep of Albert Street with welfare checks at 11 Angels Bar and Albert Mart; patrolling lower Albert Street.
Maintaining presence at Aotea Gifts in the middle of lower Albert Street.
Full sweep of lower Albert Street, all clear; patrolling Quay Street.
Full sweep of Quay Street; commencing welfare checks down the Viaduct.
Full sweep of the Viaduct with welfare checks at Dannys, Rosies Hot Cantina and The Fox, all clear, no issues. Patrolling up Customs Street West.
Welfare check along Customs Street; arrived at Britomart and commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Britomart with a welfare check at McDonald's, all clear. Patrolling to Headquarters to commence the 30-minute break.
Arrived at Headquarters; commencing the 30-minute break.
Standing by waiting for the night guard to arrive.
Received a call from management regarding a group of young individuals causing havoc at Partridge; en route to the location.
The young individuals were seen hopping off the bus; standing by at McDonald's Queen Street for any issues.
Afternoon shift concluded; handing over to the Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio. All photos and videos to be attached to the end-of-shift report.
Full sweep of Darby Street with welfare checks, all clear.
Arrived at Bar 101; standing by showing presence.
Welfare check at Bar 101, all clear; patrolling down Queen Street.
Full sweep of Queen Street with a welfare check at 77 Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, all clear, no issues.
Standing by at Reign N Pour.
Welfare check at Reign N Pour and Kemuri along with their guards, all clear; patrolling down Quay Street.
Full sweep at the corner of Quay Street; commencing welfare checks down the Viaduct.
Full sweep of the Viaduct with welfare checks at Dannys, Lulas, Rosies Hot Cantina and The Fox, all clear; patrolling down Quay Street.
Maintaining presence at Reign N Pour.
Full sweep of Quay Street; arrived at Britomart and commencing a sweep of the area.
Response call from Bar 101 regarding a female individual refusing to leave and having heated altercations with Bar 101 staff; en route to the location.
Arrived at the response location; the female individual had already left the area and could not be found. Standing by at Bar 101 maintaining presence for any issues.
Welfare check at Bar 101, all clear; patrolling to High Street.
Welfare check along Victoria Street West; patrolling down High Street.
Arrived at Freyberg Place; commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Freyberg Place with welfare checks at O'Connell Street, Chancery Street and Circle K, all clear; continuing down High Street.
Response call from Bar 101 regarding a male vagrant outside the premises disturbing customers, shouting and swearing; en route to the location.

Arrived at the location; the male vagrant was walking around outside Bar 101. Kindly approached the individual, politely asked him not to get into heated altercations with members of the public and moved him along. Standing by at Bar 101 maintaining presence.
Welfare check at Bar 101, all clear; patrolling up Victoria Street.
Full sweep of Victoria Street with welfare checks at 77 Convenience Store and Skymart Convenience Store, all clear; patrolling Federal Street.
Full sweep of Federal Street, all clear; arrived at Federal Square and commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Federal Square; continuing patrols down the bottom half of Federal Street.
Full sweep of Federal Street; patrolling through Fanshawe Street.
Fanshawe Street all clear, no issues; patrolling through Customs Street West.
Welfare check along Customs Street West; arrived at Britomart and commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Britomart with welfare checks at McDonald's and the public area, all clear; heading back to Headquarters to charge the Ops Phone.
Arrived at Headquarters; charging the Ops Phone due to low percentage.
Standing by at HQ charging the Ops Phone (04:00–04:45).
Ops Phone charging complete; commencing patrols.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling up Wellesley Street to Lorne Street.
Welfare check along Wellesley Street; patrolling Lorne Street.
Welfare check at the Lorne Street staircase mural centre, all clear.
Full sweep of the whole of Lorne Street, all clear; patrolling High Street.
Arrived at Freyberg Place; commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Freyberg Place with welfare checks at O'Connell Street and Chancery Street, all clear.
The whole of High Street all clear, no issues; heading back to Headquarters.
Arrived at Headquarters awaiting guard handover.
Currently in the office awaiting guard handover.
Night shift concluded; handing over to the Morning Shift.
